drums.tags: Funk rock featuring a prominent slap bass technique. The bassline utilizes percussive thumb slaps and finger pops in a syncopated sixteenth-note pattern. A clean electric guitar plays rhythmic muted scratches and staccato chords on the upbeats. The drum kit maintains a steady groove with a crisp snare and a tight hi-hat pattern. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E minor. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the percussive attack of the strings. The arrangement focuses on the interplay between the bass and the drum kit's kick and snare syncopation.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[slap bass solo, percussive thumb hits and pops]

[Main Groove]
[clean electric guitar enters with muted scratches]
[drum kit enters with syncopated kick and snare]
[bass continues sixteenth-note slap pattern]

bass.tags: Lo-fi hip hop track at 85 BPM in the key of C minor. A Rhodes electric piano plays a four-bar progression of jazzy seventh chords with a soft tremolo effect and high-frequency roll-off. The drum kit features a muffled, saturated kick drum hitting on beats 1 and 3, with a crisp, layered snare on beats 2 and 4. A steady 16th-note closed hi-hat pattern includes occasional velocity variations and subtle swing. A warm, sub-heavy synth bass follows the root notes of the piano chords with a slight portamento between transitions. A recurring vinyl crackle and hiss layer persists throughout the arrangement. A melodic lead is provided by a sampled, filtered flute that plays short, pentatonic phrases with heavy reverb and delay.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle and hiss begins]
[Rhodes electric piano enters with tremolo chords]

[Main Section]
[saturated kick and snare enter]
[16th-note closed hi-hats]
[sub synth bass enters]
[filtered flute lead plays melodic phrases with delay]

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[Rhodes piano fades out]
[vinyl crackle lingers and fades]
